title: Lining up columns
hints: A number between % and the verb is a width: %5d right-aligns an int in 5 columns. A minus flag, %-10s, left-aligns instead.
%8.2f means width 8 with 2 digits after the point. For the last line you need %q (quoted string), %x (hex), %08b (binary, zero-padded to 8), %+d (always show the sign) and %T (the type).
